desktop.summary: {login} · {count} in the last year · {streak} day streak
desktop.title: GitHub Contributions

plugin.description: A GitHub contribution calendar as a Noctalia desktop widget.
plugin.name: GitHub Contributions

cell_size.description: Width in pixels of each contribution day cell. Smaller cells make the whole calendar narrower.
cell_size.label: Cell size

desktop_color.description: Accent color of the contribution heatmap. The four activity levels are derived from this color. The default follows the theme (primary color).
desktop_color.label: Heatmap color

refresh_interval.description: How often GitHub contribution data refreshes automatically.
refresh_interval.label: Refresh interval

heatmap_only.label: Heatmap only
heatmap_only.description: Show only the contribution heatmap grid, without the header, footer, or month and weekday labels.

wrap.label: Wrap into rows
wrap.description: Split the year into stacked blocks so the widget is narrower and taller instead of one long strip. Off keeps a single row of weeks.

year.label: Year
year.description: Which year the contribution calendar covers. Changing it refetches the data.

status.auth_error: GitHub CLI needs authentication: gh auth login -h github.com
status.invalid_response: GitHub returned an unexpected contribution calendar.
status.missing_gh: GitHub CLI (gh) is required to load activity.
status.no_data: No contribution data is available yet.
status.request_error: GitHub Contributions could not reach GitHub.
